related.title: cuSPARSE CSR：稀疏格式的容量損益
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：符號與尺度對應正確，非量化張量及暫存另外揭露，模型品質實測。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Signs/scales align, unquantized tensors/workspace are disclosed, and quality is tested.
related.difference: 包含索引計算容量，保留空列與列偏移的正確性。
related.differenceEn: Include indices in capacity and preserve empty-row/offset correctness.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 每組G個4-bit權重和一個16-bit尺度，平均位元/權重=4+16/G。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 N=1048576權重、G128、對稱量化無zero-point；尺度FP16，不含檔案標頭。 容量=N×4/8+(N/128)×2=540672 bytes=528 KiB。

CSR容量=nnz(valueBytes+indexBytes)+(rows+1)offsetBytes；稠密容量=rows×cols×valueBytes。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 100×100矩陣，FP16值2 bytes、欄索引與列偏移各4 bytes，nnz2000。 CSR=2000×6+101×4=12404 bytes；稠密20000 bytes。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A group of G four-bit weights plus one 16-bit scale averages4+16/G bits/weight. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. N1048576 weights, G128, symmetric quantization without zero points; FP16 scales, excluding headers. Storage=540672 bytes=528 KiB.

CSR bytes=nnz(valueBytes+indexBytes)+(rows+1)offsetBytes; dense bytes=rows×cols×valueBytes. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 100×100 matrix, FP16 values2 bytes, indices/offsets4 bytes, nnz2000. CSR12404 bytes versus dense20000 bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

逐層用 r新=r舊+(k−1)j舊、j新=j舊s；r是輸入像素跨度，j是抽樣間距。；教學鏈初值r=1,j=1；第一層k11,s4，池化k3,s2，再卷積k5,s1。；r=11+2×4+4×8=51 px；最後k由5改3，r=35 px。

At each layer r_new=r_old+(k−1)j_old and j_new=j_old s; r is input span and j sampling spacing.; Teaching chain starts r=1,j=1: convolution k11,s4; pool k3,s2; convolution k5,s1.; r=11+2×4+4×8=51 px; changing the last kernel from5 to3 gives35 px.
